lead.headline: Rice is out again — and Kmet's season is over: claim Loveland
lead.deck: Friday cleared Golden, Pickens and Jacobs. Start Jacobs before 11:00 Sunday; claim Loveland and drop Stroud before Wednesday.
lead.body: Start with the bad news: Rashee Rice is ruled out for a second straight week, and you still trail Furia Regia 41.5 to 0 with ESPN at 38%. The rest of Friday went your way. Matthew Golden and Josh Jacobs carry no designation, and George Pickens practised in full with Dallas listing nobody — this morning's two fallback cards are stood down. Jacobs is the projection's back by 0.9 over Ollie Gordon, so swap him in before Gordon kicks off at 11:00 Sunday. And Cole Kmet's knee is season-ending: Colston Loveland, 12 targets on Thursday, is Chicago's tight end now. Claim him before Wednesday 01:00 and drop C.J. Stroud, whose bye-cover job ends Sunday — not Rice, who could be back next week.
